title: एकविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Consecrated as general, Skanda sets out with Rudra and the gods to Bhadravata. The demons led by Mahisha attack and the gods are routed, but Skanda hurls his spear, splits Mahisha and slaughters the demon host; Markandeya ends with the merit of hearing Skanda's birth.
summary.kn: ಸೇನಾಪತಿಯಾಗಿ ಅಭಿಷಿಕ್ತನಾದ ಸ್ಕಂದನು ರುದ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ದೇವತೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಭದ್ರವಟಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮಹಿಷನ ನೇತೃತ್ವದ ದಾನವರು ಆಕ್ರಮಿಸಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಸೋತು ಓಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆದರೆ ಸ್ಕಂದನು ಶಕ್ತ್ಯಾಯುಧ ಎಸೆದು ಮಹಿಷನನ್ನು ಸೀಳಿ ದಾನವಸೈನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಂಹರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸ್ಕಂದಜನ್ಮಶ್ರವಣದ ಫಲದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ಮುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: सेनापति के रूप में अभिषिक्त स्कन्द रुद्र और देवताओं के साथ भद्रवट की ओर निकलते हैं। महिष के नेतृत्व में दैत्य आक्रमण करते हैं और देवता भाग खड़े होते हैं, पर स्कन्द शक्ति फेंककर महिष को चीर देते हैं और दैत्यसेना का संहार करते हैं; मार्कण्डेय स्कन्द-जन्म सुनने के पुण्य के साथ कथा समाप्त करते हैं।
summary.te: సేనాపతిగా అభిషిక్తుడైన స్కందుడు రుద్రుడు, దేవతలతో భద్రవటానికి బయలుదేరుతాడు. మహిషుని నాయకత్వంలో దానవులు దాడి చేసి దేవతలు ఓడి పారిపోతారు, కానీ స్కందుడు శక్తిని విసిరి మహిషుని చీల్చి దానవసేనను సంహరిస్తాడు; స్కందజనన శ్రవణ ఫలంతో మార్కండేయుడు ముగిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: சேனாபதியாக அபிஷேகம் பெற்ற ஸ்கந்தன் ருத்ரனுடனும் தேவர்களுடனும் பத்ரவடத்துக்குப் புறப்படுகிறான். மஹிஷன் தலைமையில் அசுரர்கள் தாக்கத் தேவர்கள் சிதறி ஓட, ஸ்கந்தன் சக்தி வேலை எறிந்து மஹிஷனைப் பிளந்து அசுரப் படையை அழிக்கிறான்; ஸ்கந்தனின் பிறப்பைக் கேட்பதன் பலனுடன் மார்க்கண்டேயர் முடிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: സേനാപതിയായി അഭിഷിക്തനായ സ്കന്ദൻ രുദ്രനോടും ദേവന്മാരോടുമൊപ്പം ഭദ്രവതത്തിലേക്ക് പുറപ്പെടുന്നു. മഹിഷന്റെ നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ അസുരന്മാർ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു, ദേവന്മാർ തോൽക്കുന്നു; പക്ഷേ സ്കന്ദൻ തന്റെ ശൂലം എറിഞ്ഞ് മഹിഷനെ പിളർക്കുന്നു, അസുരസൈന്യത്തെ കൂട്ടക്കൊല ചെയ്യുന്നു. സ്കന്ദന്റെ ജനനം കേൾക്കുന്നതിന്റെ പുണ്യം പറഞ്ഞ് മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.221; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
यदाभिषिक्तो भगवान्सेनापत्येन पावकिः ।
तदा संप्रस्थितः श्रीमान्हृष्टो भद्रवटं हरः ।
रथेनादित्यवर्णेन पार्वत्या सहितः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: "When Agni's son, the blessed Skanda, was consecrated as commander, Hara, glorious and delighted, set out for Bhadravata in a chariot of sun-like radiance, with Parvati."

verses.text:
सहस्रं तस्य सिंहानां तस्मिन्युक्तं रथोत्तमे ।
उत्पपात दिवं शुभ्रं कालेनाभिप्रचोदितः ॥

meaning.en: "A thousand lions were yoked to that best of chariots; driven by time, they leapt up into the shining sky."

verses.text:
ते पिबन्त इवाकाशं त्रासयन्तश्चराचरान् ।
सिंहा नभस्यगच्छन्त नदन्तश्चारुकेसराः ॥

meaning.en: "Seeming to drink the sky and frighten all moving and unmoving beings, the lions with their lovely manes went roaring through the heavens."

verses.text:
तस्मिन्रथे पशुपतिः स्थितो भात्युमया सह ।
विद्युता सहितः सूर्यः सेन्द्रचापे घने यथा ॥

meaning.en: "In that chariot Pashupati stood shining with Uma, like the sun with lightning in a cloud bearing a rainbow."

verses.text:
अग्रतस्तस्य भगवान्धनेशो गुह्यकैः सह ।
आस्थाय रुचिरं याति पुष्पकं नरवाहनः ॥

meaning.en: "Before him went the blessed lord of wealth with the guhyakas, riding the lovely Pushpaka, carried by men."

verses.text:
ऐरावतं समास्थाय शक्रश्चापि सुरैः सह ।
पृष्ठतोऽनुययौ यान्तं वरदं वृषभध्वजम् ॥

meaning.en: "Shakra, mounted on Airavata, followed behind with the gods the boon-giving bull-bannered one as he went."

verses.text:
जम्भकैर्यक्षरक्षोभिः स्रग्विभिः समलंकृतः ।
यात्यमोघो महायक्षो दक्षिणं पक्षमास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: "The great yaksha Amogha, adorned with garlands, went on the right wing with jambhakas, yakshas and rakshasas."

verses.text:
तस्य दक्षिणतो देवा मरुतश्चित्रयोधिनः ।
गच्छन्ति वसुभिः सार्धं रुद्रैश्च सह संगताः ॥

meaning.en: "On his right went the gods, the Maruts who fight in varied ways, together with the Vasus and Rudras."

verses.text:
यमश्च मृत्युना सार्धं सर्वतः परिवारितः ।
घोरैर्व्याधिशतैर्याति घोररूपवपुस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: "Yama with Death, surrounded on all sides by hundreds of terrible diseases, went in a fearsome form."

verses.text:
यमस्य पृष्ठतश्चैव घोरस्त्रिशिखरः शितः ।
विजयो नाम रुद्रस्य याति शूलः स्वलंकृतः ॥

meaning.en: "Behind Yama went Rudra's sharp, terrible, three-pointed trident named Vijaya, well adorned."

verses.text:
तमुग्रपाशो वरुणो भगवान्सलिलेश्वरः ।
परिवार्य शनैर्याति यादोभिर्विविधैर्वृतः ॥

meaning.en: "Varuna, the blessed lord of waters with his dreadful noose, followed it slowly, surrounded by various water creatures."

verses.text:
पृष्ठतो विजयस्यापि याति रुद्रस्य पट्टिशः ।
गदामुसलशक्त्याद्यैर्वृतः प्रहरणोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: "Behind Vijaya went Rudra's pattisha, surrounded by the best weapons, mace, club, spear and others."

verses.text:
पट्टिशं त्वन्वगाद्राजंश्छत्रं रौद्रं महाप्रभम् ।
कमण्डलुश्चाप्यनु तं महर्षिगणसंवृतः ॥

meaning.en: "After the pattisha, king, came Rudra's radiant umbrella, and then the kamandalu, surrounded by hosts of great sages."

verses.text:
तस्य दक्षिणतो भाति दण्डो गच्छञ्श्रिया वृतः ।
भृग्वङ्गिरोभिः सहितो देवैश्चाप्यभिपूजितः ॥

meaning.en: "On his right the staff shone as it went, wrapped in glory, with Bhrigus and Angirases and honored by the gods."

verses.text:
एषां तु पृष्ठतो रुद्रो विमले स्यन्दने स्थितः ।
याति संहर्षयन्सर्वांस्तेजसा त्रिदिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: "Behind them Rudra rode in a spotless chariot, gladdening all the dwellers of heaven with his power."

verses.text:
ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च गन्धर्वा भुजगास्तथा ।
नद्यो नदा द्रुमाश्चैव तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः ॥

meaning.en: "Sages and gods, gandharvas and serpents, rivers and great rivers, trees, and troops of apsarases..."

verses.text:
नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्चैव देवानां शिशवश्च ये ।
स्त्रियश्च विविधाकारा यान्ति रुद्रस्य पृष्ठतः ।
सृजन्त्यः पुष्पवर्षाणि चारुरूपा वराङ्गनाः ॥

meaning.en: "constellations and planets, the children of the gods, and women of many forms went behind Rudra, lovely, fair-limbed women scattering showers of flowers."

verses.text:
पर्जन्यश्चाप्यनुययौ नमस्कृत्य पिनाकिनम् ।
छत्रं तु पाण्डुरं सोमस्तस्य मूर्धन्यधारयत् ।
चामरे चापि वायुश्च गृहीत्वाग्निश्च विष्ठितौ ॥

meaning.en: "Parjanya also followed after bowing to the bearer of the Pinaka. Soma held a white umbrella over his head, and Vayu and Agni stood holding two fly-whisks."

verses.text:
शक्रश्च पृष्ठतस्तस्य याति राजञ्श्रिया वृतः ।
सह राजर्षिभिः सर्वैः स्तुवानो वृषकेतनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Shakra went behind him, king, in splendor, with all the royal sages, praising the bull-bannered one."

verses.text:
गौरी विद्याथ गान्धारी केशिनी मित्रसाह्वया ।
सावित्र्या सह सर्वास्ताः पार्वत्या यान्ति पृष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: "Gauri, Vidya, Gandhari, Keshini and Mitra went behind Parvati, along with Savitri."

verses.text:
तत्र विद्यागणाः सर्वे ये केचित्कविभिः कृताः ।
यस्य कुर्वन्ति वचनं सेन्द्रा देवाश्चमूमुखे ॥

meaning.en: "There were all the troops of spells made by the poets, whose word Indra and the gods obey at the head of the army."

verses.text:
स गृहीत्वा पताकां तु यात्यग्रे राक्षसो ग्रहः ।
व्यापृतस्तु श्मशाने यो नित्यं रुद्रस्य वै सखा ।
पिङ्गलो नाम यक्षेन्द्रो लोकस्यानन्ददायकः ॥

meaning.en: "The rakshasa graha, always busy in the cemetery, Rudra's friend, Pingala, lord of yakshas, giver of joy to the world, went in front carrying the banner."

verses.text:
एभिः स सहितस्तत्र ययौ देवो यथासुखम् ।
अग्रतः पृष्ठतश्चैव न हि तस्य गतिर्ध्रुवा ॥

meaning.en: "With these the god went there at ease, in front and behind; for his movement is never fixed."

verses.text:
रुद्रं सत्कर्मभिर्मर्त्याः पूजयन्तीह दैवतम् ।
शिवमित्येव यं प्राहुरीशं रुद्रं पिनाकिनम् ।
भावैस्तु विविधाकारैः पूजयन्ति महेश्वरम् ॥

meaning.en: "Mortals here worship Rudra as a god with good deeds. They call him Shiva, Ishvana, Rudra, the bearer of the Pinaka, and worship Maheshvara with feelings of many kinds."

verses.text:
देवसेनापतिस्त्वेवं देवसेनाभिरावृतः ।
अनुगच्छति देवेशं ब्रह्मण्यः कृत्तिकासुतः ॥

meaning.en: "So the commander of the gods' army, surrounded by the gods' forces, Krittika's son, devoted to brahmins, followed the lord of the gods."

verses.text:
अथाब्रवीन्महासेनं महादेवो बृहद्वचः ।
सप्तमं मारुतस्कन्धं रक्ष नित्यमतन्द्रितः ॥

meaning.en: "Then Mahadeva said to Mahasena in a deep voice, 'Always guard the seventh wind-sphere without laziness.'"

verses.text: स्कन्द उवाच

meaning.en: Skanda said:

verses.text:
सप्तमं मारुतस्कन्धं पालयिष्याम्यहं प्रभो ।
यदन्यदपि मे कार्यं देव तद्वद माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: "'I will guard the seventh wind-sphere, lord. Tell me quickly, god, any other task of mine.'"

verses.text: रुद्र उवाच

meaning.en: Rudra said:

verses.text:
कार्येष्वहं त्वया पुत्र संद्रष्टव्यः सदैव हि ।
दर्शनान्मम भक्त्या च श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "'My son, you must always see me when there are tasks to be done. By seeing me and by devotion you will gain the highest good.'"

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा विससर्जैनं परिष्वज्य महेष्वरः ।
विसर्जिते ततः स्कन्दे बभूवौत्पातिकं महत् ।
सहसैव महाराज देवान्सर्वान्प्रमोहयत् ॥

meaning.en: "Having said this and embraced him, Maheshvara dismissed him. After Skanda was dismissed, a great omen arose, great king, suddenly confusing all the gods."

verses.text:
जज्वाल खं सनक्षत्रं प्रमूढं भुवनं भृशम् ।
चचाल व्यनदच्चोर्वी तमोभूतं जगत्प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: "The sky with its stars blazed, the world was greatly bewildered, the earth shook and roared, and the world became darkness, lord."

verses.text:
ततस्तद्दारुणं दृष्ट्वा क्षुभितः शंकरस्तदा ।
उमा चैव महाभागा देवाश्च समहर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: "Seeing that dreadful sight, Shankara was disturbed, and so were Uma, the gods and the great sages."

verses.text:
ततस्तेषु प्रमूढेषु पर्वताम्बुदसंनिभम् ।
नानाप्रहरणं घोरमदृश्यत महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: "While they were confused, a terrible great force appeared, like mountains and clouds, with many weapons."

verses.text:
तद्धि घोरमसंख्येयं गर्जच्च विविधा गिरः ।
अभ्यद्रवद्रणे देवान्भगवन्तं च शंकरम् ॥

meaning.en: "That fearsome, innumerable host, roaring with various cries, rushed in battle at the gods and the blessed Shankara."

verses.text:
तैर्विसृष्टान्यनीकेषु बाणजालान्यनेकशः ।
पर्वताश्च शतघ्न्यश्च प्रासाश्च परिघा गदाः ॥

meaning.en: "Showers of arrows in many forms were let loose by them on the armies, and mountains, shataghnis, spears, clubs and maces."

verses.text:
निपतद्भिश्च तैर्घोरैर्देवानीकं महायुधैः ।
क्षणेन व्यद्रवत्सर्वं विमुखं चाप्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: "As those terrible great weapons fell, the army of the gods in an instant fled and was seen turned away."

verses.text:
निकृत्तयोधनागाश्वं कृत्तायुधमहारथम् ।
दानवैरर्दितं सैन्यं देवानां विमुखं बभौ ॥

meaning.en: "With soldiers, elephants and horses cut down, weapons broken and great chariots shattered, the gods' army, harassed by danavas, looked defeated."

verses.text:
असुरैर्वध्यमानं तत्पावकैरिव काननम् ।
अपतद्दग्धभूयिष्ठं महाद्रुमवनं यथा ॥

meaning.en: "Slain by the asuras as a forest by fires, the army fell, like a great grove of trees mostly burnt."

verses.text:
ते विभिन्नशिरोदेहाः प्रच्यवन्ते दिवौकसः ।
न नाथमध्यगच्छन्त वध्यमाना महारणे ॥

meaning.en: "With heads and bodies split, the dwellers of heaven fell. Being killed in that great battle, they found no protector."

verses.text:
अथ तद्विद्रुतं सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा देवः पुरंदरः ।
आश्वासयन्नुवाचेदं बलवद्दानवार्दितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then the god Purandara, seeing that army fleeing, hard pressed by the strong danavas, reassured them and said this."

verses.text:
भयं त्यजत भद्रं वः शूराः शस्त्राणि गृह्णत ।
कुरुध्वं विक्रमे बुद्धिं मा वः काचिद्व्यथा भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: "'Give up fear, may you be well. Take up your weapons, heroes. Set your minds on valor, and let no pain come to you.'"

verses.text:
जयतैनान्सुदुर्वृत्तान्दानवान्घोरदर्शनान् ।
अभिद्रवत भद्रं वो मया सह महासुरान् ॥

meaning.en: "'Conquer these wicked, terrible-looking danavas. Rush at the great asuras with me, may you be well.'"

verses.text:
शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा समाश्वस्ता दिवौकसः ।
दानवान्प्रत्ययुध्यन्त शक्रं कृत्वा व्यपाश्रयम् ॥

meaning.en: "Hearing Shakra's words, the dwellers of heaven took heart and fought the danavas, making Shakra their refuge."

verses.text:
ततस्ते त्रिदशाः सर्वे मरुतश्च महाबलाः ।
प्रत्युद्ययुर्महावेगाः साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: "Then all the thirty gods, the mighty Maruts and the Sadhyas with the Vasus, advanced with great speed."

verses.text:
तैर्विसृष्टान्यनीकेषु क्रुद्धैः शस्त्राणि संयुगे ।
शराश्च दैत्यकायेषु पिबन्ति स्मासृगुल्बणम् ॥

meaning.en: "The weapons they angrily hurled in the ranks and the arrows in the daitya bodies drank their blood greedily."

verses.text:
तेषां देहान्विनिर्भिद्य शरास्ते निशितास्तदा ।
निष्पतन्तो अदृश्यन्त नगेभ्य इव पन्नगाः ॥

meaning.en: "Splitting their bodies, those sharp arrows were seen coming out like snakes from mountains."

verses.text:
तानि दैत्यशरीराणि निर्भिन्नानि स्म सायकैः ।
अपतन्भूतले राजंश्छिन्नाभ्राणीव सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: "Those daitya bodies pierced by shafts fell to the ground everywhere, king, like torn clouds."

verses.text:
ततस्तद्दानवं सैन्यं सर्वैर्देवगणैर्युधि ।
त्रासितं विविधैर्बाणैः कृतं चैव पराङ्मुखम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then that army of danavas, terrified by all the hosts of gods in battle with various arrows, was turned back."

verses.text:
अथोत्क्रुष्टं तदा हृष्टैः सर्वैर्देवैरुदायुधैः ।
संहतानि च तूर्याणि तदा सर्वाण्यनेकशः ॥

meaning.en: "Then all the gods, glad and with weapons raised, shouted, and many instruments were struck together."

verses.text:
एवमन्योन्यसंयुक्तं युद्धमासीत्सुदारुणम् ।
देवानां दानवानां च मांसशोणितकर्दमम् ॥

meaning.en: "So there was a most terrible battle, joined one to the other, of gods and danavas, a mire of flesh and blood."

verses.text:
अनयो देवलोकस्य सहसैव व्यदृश्यत ।
तथा हि दानवा घोरा विनिघ्नन्ति दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: "Disaster for the world of the gods suddenly seemed near, for the terrible danavas were slaying the dwellers of heaven."

verses.text:
ततस्तूर्यप्रणादाश्च भेरीणां च महास्वनाः ।
बभूवुर्दानवेन्द्राणां सिंहनादाश्च दारुणाः ॥

meaning.en: "Then there came the blast of trumpets, the great din of drums and fierce lion-roars of the danava chiefs."

verses.text:
अथ दैत्यबलाद्घोरान्निष्पपात महाबलः ।
दानवो महिषो नाम प्रगृह्य विपुलं गिरिम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then from the terrible daitya host the mighty danava named Mahisha rushed out, carrying a huge mountain."

verses.text:
ते तं घनैरिवादित्यं दृष्ट्वा संपरिवारितम् ।
समुद्यतगिरिं राजन्व्यद्रवन्त दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: "Seeing him surrounded like the sun among clouds, with the mountain raised, king, the dwellers of heaven fled."

verses.text:
अथाभिद्रुत्य महिषो देवांश्चिक्षेप तं गिरिम् ।
पतता तेन गिरिणा देवसैन्यस्य पार्थिव ।
भीमरूपेण निहतमयुतं प्रापतद्भुवि ॥

meaning.en: "Rushing at the gods, Mahisha hurled the mountain. Falling in terrible form on the gods' army, king, it killed ten thousand, who fell to the ground."

verses.text:
अथ तैर्दानवैः सार्धं महिषस्त्रासयन्सुरान् ।
अभ्यद्रवद्रणे तूर्णं सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगानिव ॥

meaning.en: "Then Mahisha with those danavas rushed on in battle, frightening the gods, like a lion on small beasts."

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं महिषं दृष्ट्वा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः ।
व्यद्रवन्त रणे भीता विशीर्णायुधकेतनाः ॥

meaning.en: "Seeing Mahisha come, the dwellers of heaven with Indra fled in fear from the fight, their weapons and banners scattered."

verses.text:
ततः स महिषः क्रुद्धस्तूर्णं रुद्ररथं ययौ ।
अभिद्रुत्य च जग्राह रुद्रस्य रथकूबरम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then Mahisha, enraged, went swiftly to Rudra's chariot and rushing on, seized the pole-end of Rudra's chariot."

verses.text:
यदा रुद्ररथं क्रुद्धो महिषः सहसा गतः ।
रेसतू रोदसी गाढं मुमुहुश्च महर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: "When Mahisha in rage suddenly reached Rudra's chariot, heaven and earth shook hard and the great sages were bewildered."

verses.text:
व्यनदंश्च महाकाया दैत्या जलधरोपमाः ।
आसीच्च निश्चितं तेषां जितमस्माभिरित्युत ॥

meaning.en: "The huge daityas roared like clouds, and they were sure, saying, 'We have won.'"

verses.text:
तथाभूते तु भगवान्नावधीन्महिषं रणे ।
सस्मार च तदा स्कन्दं मृत्युं तस्य दुरात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: "Even so, the blessed one did not kill Mahisha in the battle; he remembered Skanda, who was that wicked one's death."

verses.text:
महिषोऽपि रथं दृष्ट्वा रौद्रं रुद्रस्य नानदत् ।
देवान्संत्रासयंश्चापि दैत्यांश्चापि प्रहर्षयन् ॥

meaning.en: "Mahisha too, seeing Rudra's fierce chariot, roared, terrifying the gods and cheering the daityas."

verses.text:
ततस्तस्मिन्भये घोरे देवानां समुपस्थिते ।
आजगाम महासेनः क्रोधात्सूर्य इव ज्वलन् ॥

meaning.en: "Then, when that terrible fear had come on the gods, Mahasena came, blazing in anger like the sun."

verses.text:
लोहिताम्बरसंवीतो लोहितस्रग्विभूषणः ।
लोहितास्यो महाबाहुर्हिरण्यकवचः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: "He wore red garments, red garlands and ornaments, with a red face, mighty arms, golden armor, a lord."

verses.text:
रथमादित्यसंकाशमास्थितः कनकप्रभम् ।
तं दृष्ट्वा दैत्यसेना सा व्यद्रवत्सहसा रणे ॥

meaning.en: "He rode a golden-bright chariot like the sun. Seeing him, the daitya army suddenly fled in the battle."

verses.text:
स चापि तां प्रज्वलितां महिषस्य विदारिणीम् ।
मुमोच शक्तिं राजेन्द्र महासेनो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: "Mahasena, mighty, king of kings, hurled that blazing spear that splits Mahisha."

verses.text:
सा मुक्ताभ्यहनच्छक्तिर्महिषस्य शिरो महत् ।
पपात भिन्ने शिरसि महिषस्त्यक्तजीवितः ॥

meaning.en: "The spear, released, struck Mahisha's great head. His head split and Mahisha fell, his life gone."

verses.text:
क्षिप्ताक्षिप्ता तु सा शक्तिर्हत्वा शत्रून्सहस्रशः ।
स्कन्दहस्तमनुप्राप्ता दृश्यते देवदानवैः ॥

meaning.en: "The spear, thrown again and again, killed enemies by the thousand and returned to Skanda's hand, as the gods and danavas saw."

verses.text:
प्रायः शरैर्विनिहता महासेनेन धीमता ।
शेषा दैत्यगणा घोरा भीतास्त्रस्ता दुरासदैः ।
स्कन्दस्य पार्षदैर्हत्वा भक्षिताः शतसंघशः ॥

meaning.en: "Most of the terrible daitya hosts were slain by the wise Mahasena's arrows; the rest, terrified, were killed and eaten by hundreds by Skanda's formidable attendants."

verses.text:
दानवान्भक्षयन्तस्ते प्रपिबन्तश्च शोणितम् ।
क्षणान्निर्दानवं सर्वमकार्षुर्भृशहर्षिताः ॥

meaning.en: "Devouring the danavas and drinking their blood, they greatly rejoiced and in a moment left the whole field without danavas."

verses.text:
तमांसीव यथा सूर्यो वृक्षानग्निर्घनान्खगः ।
तथा स्कन्दोऽजयच्छत्रून्स्वेन वीर्येण कीर्तिमान् ॥

meaning.en: "As the sun does darkness, fire does trees, and wind does clouds, so the renowned Skanda defeated his enemies by his own valor."

verses.text:
संपूज्यमानस्त्रिदशैरभिवाद्य महेश्वरम् ।
शुशुभे कृत्तिकापुत्रः प्रकीर्णांशुरिवांशुमान् ॥

meaning.en: "Honored by the gods, he bowed to Maheshvara, and Krittika's son shone like the sun scattering rays."

verses.text:
नष्टशत्रुर्यदा स्कन्दः प्रयातश्च महेश्वरम् ।
अथाब्रवीन्महासेनं परिष्वज्य पुरंदरः ॥

meaning.en: "When his enemies were destroyed and Skanda had gone to Maheshvara, Indra embraced Mahasena and spoke."

verses.text:
ब्रह्मदत्तवरः स्कन्द त्वयायं महिषो हतः ।
देवास्तृणमया यस्य बभूवुर्जयतां वर ।
सोऽयं त्वया महाबाहो शमितो देवकण्टकः ॥

meaning.en: "'Skanda, this Mahisha, who had a boon from Brahma and for whom the gods had been like straw, best of conquerors, you have quelled, mighty-armed one; that thorn of the gods is gone.'"

verses.text:
शतं महिषतुल्यानां दानवानां त्वया रणे ।
निहतं देवशत्रूणां यैर्वयं पूर्वतापिताः ॥

meaning.en: "'A hundred danavas like Mahisha, the enemies of the gods who had tormented us before, were killed by you in battle.'"

verses.text:
तावकैर्भक्षिताश्चान्ये दानवाः शतसंघशः ।
अजेयस्त्वं रणेऽरीणामुमापतिरिव प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: "'Others were eaten by your followers, hundreds of troops of danavas. You cannot be conquered by enemies in battle, lord, like the lord of Uma.'"

verses.text:
एतत्ते प्रथमं देव ख्यातं कर्म भविष्यति ।
त्रिषु लोकेषु कीर्तिश्च तवाक्षय्या भविष्यति ।
वशगाश्च भविष्यन्ति सुरास्तव सुरात्मज ॥

meaning.en: "'This will be your first famous deed, god; your fame will be imperishable in the three worlds, and the gods will be under your sway, son of the god.'"

verses.text:
महासेनेत्येवमुक्त्वा निवृत्तः सह दैवतैः ।
अनुज्ञातो भगवता त्र्यम्बकेन शचीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: "Having called him Mahasena, Indra turned back with the gods, with the blessed Tryambaka's permission."

verses.text:
गतो भद्रवटं रुद्रो निवृत्ताश्च दिवौकसः ।
उक्ताश्च देवा रुद्रेण स्कन्दं पश्यत मामिव ॥

meaning.en: "Rudra went to Bhadravata, and the dwellers of heaven turned back. Rudra told the gods, 'See Skanda as you see me.'"

verses.text:
स हत्वा दानवगणान्पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः ।
एकाह्नैवाजयत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं वह्निनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: "After killing the troops of danavas and being honored by the great sages, Agni's joy conquered all the three worlds in a single day."

verses.text:
स्कन्दस्य य इदं जन्म पठते सुसमाहितः ।
स पुष्टिमिह संप्राप्य स्कन्दसालोक्यतामियात् ॥

meaning.en: "Whoever, with deep attention, recites this account of Skanda's birth gains growth and prosperity here and reaches Skanda's world."
